visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young woman with long, straight brown hair sitting at a light-colored table in a bright, modern room. She is wearing a white sleeveless knit top and is looking down at a black smartphone she holds in her left hand. To her right, a green product box and a white tablet are placed on the table, while a white coffee cup sits on a saucer to her left. Large windows in the background reveal blurred urban structures and green foliage, suggesting a daytime city setting. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up where the woman, now wearing a light cream-colored shirt, opens a small green sachet and pours white powder directly into her mouth. She is sitting in the same indoor environment near the window. The lighting is soft and bright, highlighting her facial features and the product's packaging. (3) The camera transitions to a car interior where the woman is seen from a slightly high angle, wearing a black strapless top and a seatbelt. She holds a sachet and repeats the action of consuming the probiotic powder. The background through the car window shows moving city elements, and the lighting is slightly harsher natural daylight. (4) The setting shifts to a gym mirror selfie perspective. The woman is wearing a pink sports bra and white shorts, holding her phone to record herself while presenting the green sachet to the camera. Fitness equipment like treadmills are visible in the background reflection. (5) Back at the indoor table, the woman leans her head on two stacked green product boxes, smiling warmly at the camera. The boxes feature a minimalist wave design in white and light blue. A close-up shot follows, showing her placing a single sachet into a small, white quilted handbag. (6) The final sequence features close-ups of the white probiotic powder being poured onto a surface and compared with another, darker powder labeled with text. The woman continues to pose with the product boxes, holding them towards the lens with a cheerful expression before the video ends on a minimalist brand logo screen.

The background music remains constant in its rhythmic intensity and major mode tonality. (3) The vocal delivery remains steady and clear, exhibiting high articulation and moderate pitch variability. There is a short, bright 'ding' sound effect used as a transition marker as the narration highlights the convenience of the product while the BGM continues to pulse.
